summary: Genesis describes waters full of living creatures with this root. The command pairs the verb שָׁרַץ with the noun שֶׁרֶץ, a swarm.

senses.definition: Of waters, to be full of living creatures moving in them.

evidence.note: The waters are the subject of יִשְׁרְצוּ. The words שֶׁרֶץ נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה describe the living swarm with which they are to teem.
The account of the command's fulfillment uses שָׁרְצוּ of the waters and identifies the creatures moving in them.
